Each folded observation equals a single full fold (as_dict equal). Per tick, the bytes read from each stream are at most the appended bytes plus 64 plus the partial record carried from the previous tick, and zero for a stream whose size did not change. A stream whose inode changed, whose size is below its consumed offset, or whose size is below its stored last-read size is refolded from its start. A grown stream whose 64-byte tail anchor before the consumed offset no longer matches is refolded.
